name: Surge XT
description: Open-source hybrid synthesizer: wavetable, FM, subtractive and granular engines.
about:
A hybrid synthesizer with wavetable, FM, subtractive, granular and physical-modelling oscillators, a deep modulation system and a large effects rack. It also includes a companion effects-only plugin.

One of the most actively developed open-source synths, with a big preset library.
